Today, Perion helps leading brands, agencies, and media partners deliver smarter advertising across every screen and channel.

With teams across North America, Europe, APAC, and Israel, we’re a truly global company united by innovation, collaboration, and a passion for solving complex challenges.

Our people bring together diverse perspectives, expertise, and ideas to shape the future of advertising technology.
